title: AliExpress: 23% Cashback on Affiliated Products, 1% Cashback on Unaffiliated Products ($50 Cap Per Transaction) @ TopCashback AU
body:
Deal: AliExpress: 23% Cashback on Affiliated Products, 1% Cashback on Unaffiliated Products ($50 Cap Per Transaction) @ TopCashback AU

[mystrd] Better off holding out for 11.11 if you can
[Merlict] Literally bookmarked, since I tend to swap around Aliexpress accounts.
[coldazure] Dude this is so hype. I am praying that I won't be disappointed with the deals. I've got so much random shit just waiting to be purchased.
[jv] 23% Cashback on Affiliated Products, 1% Cashback on Unaffiliated Products
That is a big difference !!!
[Hellfire] Biwin are a good option from Aliexpress. Usually need coupons plus cashback for good deals.
[bgbrendan] dammit just bought a ton of stuff yesterday cause didnt want to wait till 11.11
[safrane] I wonder what Temu's gonna do, they've been completely absent for so long.
[UncleRico] If history is any guide, an itty bitty version of whatever AliExpress is doing…
[Clear] Somehow still kicking after nearly collapsing many years ago. I remember because they shifted all of their operations to another part of the country with less strict labour laws.
[Xizor] Temu parent company were in financial troubles and lawsuits etc which i recall is why they wound back alot of the promos.
[DraggyX] AliExpress was fined a record €550 million (about $895 million AUD) by the European Commission on July 20, 2026, for failing to stop the sale of illegal, unsafe, and counterfeit products on its platform but they can still sell them to Australian market
[Xizor] Yeah, should be more of it too. Our government is more interested in gas lighting and screwing us. Probably the easier target.
[Azif] What does the new coin boost thing do, whats the best way to use it
[coldazure] Those coins are largely useless for me. Some listings allow you to pay a portion of the item using coins instead of cash. The problem is a vast majority of things I've purchased allowed only a tiny proportion of the item to be purchased with coins.
[ashar] How do I know I am ordering eligible items? Is the only way to make sure you look after the exclusions yourself or is there some filter etc?

[ce5himm] 11.11 and black Friday are not too far away, better load the cart, and wait.
[coldazure] Got a shitload of stuff just waiting. Hopefully won't be disappointed.
[Travelling panda] Thank you, purchased and already tracked
[DealHuntersXD] What are you guys buying during every cashback sale? I've just got some SSDs and laptop battery from here. Anything else worth buying from AliExpress over other retailers?
